title: Glass Dark Mode Clock
concept: Rook & Ledger: a furniture workshop that seasons every board one year per inch, told through a frosted-black calibration dial that tracks a walnut stack while its hands keep live workshop time, with glass ledger dials, a tick-ruler process and a thickness-to-delivery commission dial.
notes: Pure SVG + CSS, no WebGL. Dial layers: rim, rotating text path, 120 ticks, seasoning arc, month ring, rotating dashed ring and hex frame, glass core; hands run on Europe/London time via Intl. Reduced motion stops rotations, beam sweeps, wisps and reveals and ticks the hands once a second.
